name: tour-ceylon-frontend
description: Run Itinerary + Tourist SOS + Police + Wellness + Live Data frontends together

scripts.dev: node scripts/free-dev-ports.js && concurrently -n travel,tourist,police,wellness,livedata -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run dev --prefix itinerary/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix sos/frontend/tourist" "npm run dev --prefix sos/frontend/police" "npm run dev --prefix wellness/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix risk-management/frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix itinerary/frontend && npm install --prefix sos/frontend/tourist && npm install --prefix sos/frontend/police && npm install --prefix wellness/frontend && npm install --prefix risk-management/frontend
